name: hadhar
description: Forward any suspicious message or link, get a verdict in seconds. An n8n workflow with a tested, explainable scam-detection engine and family alerts.

scripts.setup: mkdir -p .n8n-runtime && cd .n8n-runtime && (test -f package.json || echo '{"name":"n8n-runtime","private":true}' > package.json) && npm install n8n@2.49.5 --no-audit --no-fund
